profile.comparison_limit: Figure 13's detector and sampling time are unspecified; its z/d_j ordinate is not converted to a half-width or full-width. This observer reports full AABB span.

connectivity.edge_source: native internal faces plus processor-face joins from the export
connectivity.threshold_rule: global alpha.water >= 0.9 selection, then native face-edge labels

coordinate_frame.y_axis: native mesh y; signed coordinates are retained
coordinate_frame.z_axis: native mesh z, spanwise; signed edges are retained

profile.observer: native-cell-center x bins with full native cell AABB envelopes

reference.case1_diameter_source: PDF p. 5 / printed article p. 4, Table 3
reference.cloud_and_core_threshold_source: PDF p. 6 / printed article p. 5, Section 3.1
reference.title: Liquid jet breakup in gaseous crossflow injected through a large diameter nozzle

station_assignment.aabb_contribution: full native y/z AABB for each cell assigned once by its center
station_assignment.final_edge_rule: center on the final edge enters the final bin
station_assignment.internal_edge_rule: center on an internal edge enters the higher-x bin
station_assignment.within_tolerance_of_edge: snap to the nearest edge before assignment

profile.time_value_source: numeric parse of exact native field time_name; export metadata value retained separately
